entities.name: Lord Nellick
entities.description: A wealthy human noble of Innistrad whose body was the host of Cyril Rav; he died when Rav abandoned him.

entities.name: Cyril Rav
entities.description: A necro-alchemist whose darkness possessed Lord Nellick's body and who later partnered with Jacob Hauken.

entities.name: Jacob Hauken
entities.description: A man who investigates Nellick and Cyril Rav and ends up agreeing to a partnership with Rav.

entities.name: Eloise Wicker
entities.description: A detective who visits Nellick with Jacob Hauken and later finds Nellick's corpse.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Lord Nellick lived, in a dire situation with geist attacks.

events.summary: Jacob Hauken and Eloise Wicker meet Lord Nellick, who is casual and mocking; when he shakes Eloise's hand he transfers Cyril Rav's darkness into her.
events.quote: when Nellick shook Eloise's hand, he transferred this darkness into her

events.summary: Jacob learns Nellick is Cyril Rav's host and returns to the mansion, where Nellick tries to possess him and bleeds black blood when repelled.
Cyril Rav, in Nellick's body, proposes an alliance and Jacob agrees to the partnership.
events.quote: Ultimately, Cyril and Jacob agreed on the partnership

events.summary: Rav abandons Nellick's body, which dies; Eloise later finds the corpse.
events.quote: as Rav abandoned Nellick, his body gave out

relations.note: Rav used Nellick as his host body

relations.quote: Ultimately, Cyril and Jacob agreed on the partnership
